title: loop
description: The factory loop's own bookkeeping (DECISIONS D-09): agent and wake starts and ends with their answers, owner notices, rate-cap holds and the ping breaker. Never a stage, never progress; rebuilds the loop's ledger after a lost store. Written by: the factory loop (ledger.ts loopEvent, act.ts capEventArgv, breakerEventArgv). Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

issue.description: The entry's issue, or the issue of a per-issue cap; null for work that names none.

run_id.description: The entry's run, when it has one.

pr.description: The entry's PR, when it has one.

head.description: The entry's head, when it has one.

note.description: Legacy machine-read note: kind=<kind> key=<key> status=<status> then more key=value tokens (attempts, class, rule, started, ended, agent, agentId, wake and the outcome's out= tokens), values with % and whitespace percent-encoded and none for empty, at most 500 characters before the outcome is dropped; full grammar in SPEC 7.4. Read by the factory loop (derive.ts entryFromLoop); callum-flow-event itself refuses a note without the three keys. Frozen until it moves into a payload (docs/events.md, Legacy notes).
